name: AIResponseFooter
description: AIResponseFooter is the optional group component used beneath AI-generated responses, recommendations, summaries, and agent outputs. It provides lightweight trust, attribution, source context, and post-response actions. Uses AIFeedbackBar as a sub-atom — does not duplicate it. Orange is used only for stale data, missing source, or escalation states, never as a default color.
intent: Closes the loop after every AI output. Sources ground the claim, freshness signals trust, feedback improves the model — all without competing with the response itself.

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.
